title: Make OpenAleph and FtM mappings RSL-aware
scope: Name collections by RSL case reference, carry TIN, Lekuka invoice IDs and ASYCUDA entries as FtM identifiers, and label each record with its source system

acceptance.text: Entities carry RSL identifiers and source-system labels; repeated ingest stays idempotent
Documents RSL already holds are marked as RSL-held references
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Mapping tests and native OpenAleph screenshots
